# DuckDB extension template

This project started from DuckDB's extension template, https://github.com/duckdb/extension-template:
its build files, its repository settings files (the git files and the links to DuckDB's formatting
and editor settings), `docs/UPDATING.md` and the first source layout. The template is released under
the MIT licence, and `LICENSE` here is its licence file, unmodified, which MIT asks to be kept with
the code derived from it.

The rest of this project is released under the Apache License 2.0, in the root `LICENSE`.
